$schema: Nusuk DL template contract v1 (see 14-templates-and-patterns.md; DESIGN.md › M9T)
name: Item details

band.rule: Takes the band of the service that uses it; commitment state inside it is band 2.

job: Everything needed to decide on one item: media, name and provider, description, options, then one action that adds or books it.
useFor: One item that needs more than its card can hold — several photos, a description, options such as size or colour — opened from a card, a search result, a notification or a shared link, going into a cart to be paid for later with other items.
notFor: A booking with a date, a slot or a permit (use the booking flow, where availability and holds follow other rules); an item with no options and nothing more to say than its card (let the card add it directly); an item with a flow of its own, such as an add-on task (start that flow instead); a person in a sacred window, where the page is suppressed with the rest of the service.

allowed: Toolbar · Marketplace Prodcut: back, one title and the cart with its count.
forbidden: A title that mixes the item name and its category; the flow does this and needs a decision.

allowed: Product Photo · Status On, 340 × 328, with a peek of the next photo, and Pagination.
The first photo is the one used on cards; with a single photo, pagination is hidden.
forbidden: Imagery that is not the item for sale.

allowed: Product Header: provider or brand, item name, share, and a verified mark shown only when it is true.
forbidden: A verified mark shown when it is not earned; that is a disguised ad (M4).

allowed: Product Info · State Product Description: what it is, what is included, size or weight, origin — facts first, in 3 lines before the text expands.
Proposed · product-options, a local component with no library home yet: one row per option, with a label and chips.
Nothing is selected in advance unless there is only one choice; an unavailable option stays visible and marked, not removed.
forbidden: An option selected in advance when more than one exists.
An unavailable option hidden instead of marked.

allowed: The cards-slider pattern: SectionTitle then a MediaCard row of items from the same category or bought together, after the details.
forbidden: A position between the options and the action.
An item that is not actually related; a sponsored item not labelled as an ad.

allowed: Quantity, total and one Primary action that names the outcome; the action stays enabled, and on tap it moves to a missing option and says what to choose.
forbidden: A disabled Primary used to hide validation.
A total that is not the price paid.

rules: No "selling fast" and no timers; a low stock count is stated once, as a fact, and only when it is real.
The price shown is the price paid; taxes and fees are visible before the cart, not after.
The verified mark is earned, never decorative; a related item is actually related, and a sponsored one is labelled as an ad.
Notify me sends one message when the item returns, and nothing else.
Photos carry alt text that describes the item; the gallery announces its position and the dots are never the only cue.
A selected option is exposed to screen readers and never shown by colour alone; colour options also show the colour name.

allocation.Withheld: For Dependents and Organised groups the action bar is withheld (P0); the page stays readable.

measure.success: Adds per item view, option errors per add, time from opening to adding
measure.guardrails: refunds marked not as described, removals from the cart, complaints per 1,000 requests

allocation.Inherits: Marketplace: DNA Supportive · band 6 · interrupts for offers are T3 · suppressed in sacred windows.
allocation.App level: L4 detail · inside the Marketplace. Reached from cards, search, notifications and shared links.

example.inTheFlowToday: The main action is disabled in the flow when an option is missing and when the item is out of stock; the DL rule is not to disable the main action to hide validation, so it is shown enabled here instead. Both hints in the flow open with a warning emoji, and one has a spelling error; rewritten here. Product Size Options (size and colour) is a local component with no library home, used four times, shown here as a Proposed block. The toolbar type is published as "Marketplace Prodcut" (a spelling slip) and needs two layer overrides to match the design: a dark status bar and a hidden action block. Product Info is published with a state named forTesting, and its tabs are hidden with a layer override. The toolbar title and the item name differ in the flow; deciding whether the toolbar shows the category or the item is still open. Out of stock reuses the cart bar with its quantity and total; it needs a bar of its own with Notify me only. The photo fade and the header panel are local shapes with hard-coded gradients. The verified mark’s text is 8 px in the library, below the 12 px floor; logged.
